book.title: Yesu Keriso Tuyeghana Ahiꞌahina Mark Vivireina i Girugirumiya

content: Yesu Tavine ma Viꞌaharena i Vihanahanapuwei
Yesu na dobuna i votere aharei, ma i nae au Judea po Jordan wairana i damani au maramatanei. Ma rava boruhi hi nememe auwarina po i hanahanapuhi, me mara maghamaghauna i dewadewaiya nanaꞌarena.
Ma Pharisee ghehauhi hi neꞌi po hi ghohei, da Yesu hita raudadani po hi raubayadei hipa, “Ata raugagayo* i viꞌanina da oroto awana ina aharei?”
Ma i paribeehi ipa, “Ma Moses raugagayo i amvereneiya, me i riwanei?”
Ma hipa, “Moses i viꞌanina po oroto awana raimoina pepana, ina girumi po ina verei ma muriyai ina aharei.”
Anima Yesu i paribeehi ipa, “Moses na raugagayona aubaimi i girumi babana nuwanuwami hi toghara.
Ma au karena Maimaituwa rava ‘orotona ma wavinena i dewahi.’
Ma ‘Weꞌi aubaina, oroto ayona ma amana ina votere aharehi, ma awana maiteni hina ampopo, ma hina dewamehi po tauhi viyowa emosi.’
Au karena we nanaꞌarena Maimaituwa i dewai aubaina po aiwa i emosiyeiya, yana egha rava ina viyamonehi.”
Ma hi naeme au numa, yana a tauvotagho we aubaina hi raubayadei.
Ma i paribeehi ipa, “Inapa oroto awana ina aharei ma wavine tapuna ina ravaghi, yana tavine raugagayona i raugahi.
Tayahana emosina, inapa wavine awana ina aharei ma oroto tapuna ina ravaghi, yana tavine raugagayona i raugahi.”
Yesu ma Rowarowa Muhomuhohi
Rava ghehauhi rowarowa hi nehimaꞌi Yesu auwarina po ita votepanihi, ma a tauvotagho hi ghahiyawa.

Ma Yesu i inanahi yana amona i ghaighai ma a tauvotagho i riwehi ipa, “Rowarowa ona voterehi po auwariꞌu hina neꞌi, ma egha onai ghaꞌehi, babana Maimaituwa a vitaniwaga vouna yana rava aiyavo me we tauhi rowarowahi nanaꞌarena aubaihi.
A ririwemi, rava aiya Maimaituwa a vitaniwaga vouna* egha ina vaini me we teverana nanaꞌarena, yana apo egha emoꞌemosina po ina ruini.”
Anima rowarowa i vainihi po au yapana i terehi, ma i votepanihi ma Maimaituwa i vibaghai po i viꞌahiꞌahinihi.
Oroto Mahumahurana Yawahana Maꞌemaꞌe Vavahaghana aubaina Yesu i Raubayadei

Anima, na au marana Yesu i vomahiri po i naenae, ma rava ghehauna i ruba po aunaona i raudune ma i raubayadei ipa, “Tauvihanahanapu ahiꞌahina, aiwa a dewai po yawahana maꞌemaꞌe vavahaghana ana vaini?”
Ma Yesu i riwei ipa, “Aiwa aubaina u riweꞌu da taꞌu ata ahi? Egha aiya ita ahi da Maimaituwa tauꞌavana.

Tam yana Maimaituwa a raugagayo* u haramanei. ‘Egha ma vihiraghena, egha ma viꞌawadanene, egha ma danene, egha ma terevaidegha, egha vimorumoruwei rava ahi purapura ma vaini, ma amam ma ayom ma viꞌateꞌatehi.’”
Ma i paribeei ipa, “Tauvihanahanapu, haburuꞌumai po amadoꞌi yana we raugagayohi a voteꞌeteꞌehi.”

Ma Yesu rauhogharei i inanai ma ipa, “Dewa emosiꞌava u vineboꞌai. Ma nae po am mahura atapuna ma gimarehi, ma aiwa u vaivainiya ma naiyei po yamoyamona ma verehi, ma am maiha yana apo au mara. Yamna ma dewai ma aumurina, ma neꞌi po ma votaghoꞌu.”
Tauna yana i mahura duma aubaina po maranai we babanina i nonori, yana naona i hariri ma a nuwaboyana i nae.
Yesu i inana viravira ma a tauvotagho auwarihi i vibabani ipa, “Tauhi aiyavo mahumahurahi yana i piripiri duma auwarihi, po Maimaituwa hina viꞌaninei po ahi yawahana ina vitaniwagei.”
A tauvotagho yana hi amhuna duma a babani auwarina.
Ma Yesu ipa, “Natunatuꞌu, Maimaituwa a vitaniwaga vouna ruinana yana i piripiri duma.
I piripiri po camel ighoma au gavogavona ina rui, ma i piripiri duma po rava mahumahurana Maimaituwa ita viꞌaninei po a yawahana ita vitaniwagei.”
Ahi amhuna i kwaha ma hi raubayadanameehi hipa, “Inapa we nanaꞌarena yana apo aiya yawahana maꞌemaꞌe vavahaghana ina vaini? Bo menanaꞌarena?”
Yesu i inanahi ma ipa, “Egha emoꞌemosina po rava hina viyawahanameehi, ma Maimaituwa apo ina dewai, babana ginauri atapuna Maimaituwa auwarina yana emoꞌemosina.”
Anima Peter i riwei ipa, “Ma inanai, we taiꞌwai menanaꞌarena. Boiboghi aꞌi ginauri atapuhi a voterehi ma a votaghom.”
Yesu ipa, “A ririwana dumemi, inapa aubaiꞌu ma tuyegha ahiꞌahina vidabararana aubaina, ma rava ana numa, varevarehina, novunovuna, ayona, amana, natunatuna ma ana dobu ina neꞌaharei,

yana we marina Maimaituwa apo ginauri autepana maghamaghau dumahi ina raipotoi. Ma aiwa i voterehi apo ina vainihi, ana numa, varevarehina, novunovuna, ayoyona, natunatuna ma ana dobu. Wate rava apo piripiri davodavona hina verei. Ma mara muriyai apo yawahana maꞌemaꞌe vavahaghana ina vaini.
Rava maghamaghauhi marina he tayatayaha yana apo hina vimuri, ma marina maghamaghauhi heimurihi apo hina tayaha.”
Yesu Mara Vitonuina a Hiraghe i Vibabaniyei

Yesu, a tauvotagho maitehi hi naena au Jerusalem, ma Yesu i aitayaha ma a tauvotagho ahi nuwatuhu i magha, ma tauvimuritagho ghehauhi yana hi rovo. Anima Yesu, a tauvotagho 12, i vainameehi po auririva, ma apo auwarina aiwa ina wawara i riwehi,

ipa, “Ona inanai we ta ghaeghae au Jerusalem, yana apo Taꞌu Rava Natuna hina amvereneꞌu gudutaupuyoweina* ghaeghaehi ma raugagayo tauvihanahanapuweina auwarihi po hina viꞌanineꞌu da a hiraghe. Apoma rava egha mai Judea auwarihi hina amvereneꞌu.
Po tauhi hina vijiboghiꞌu, hina hovaꞌu, hina kwapuꞌu ma hina vihiragheniꞌu. Ma maratom tonugha aumurina apo a vomahirime.”
James ma John ahi Vibagha
Anima Zebedee natunatuna James ma John hi neꞌi Yesu auwarina ma hipa, “Tauvihanahanapu, a ghohei po aꞌi vibagha aiwa auwarim yana ma dewai.”
Ma i raubayadehi ipa, “Aiwa o ghoheꞌu po aubaimi a dewai?”
Ma hi paribeei hipa, “Ma viꞌanina po au ahoꞌohohim ma au ahokeham a tughura am viguyau au marana.”
Yesu i riwehi ipa, “Egha ota hanapuwei aiwa oi gigimanei. Taumi anina po vinuwaviuva keyakana ana umaumaiya ona umai, bo ona babataito* me taꞌu ana babataito nanaꞌarena?”
Ma hi paribeei hipa, “Auwariꞌai yana anina.” Ma i riwehi ipa, “Na keyakana ana umaumaiya apo ona umai, ma me ana babataitonei nanaꞌarena ona babataito.
Ma au ahoꞌohohiꞌu bo au ahokehaꞌu tughurana, yana egha taꞌu ghariꞌuwei po a veremi, Maimaituwa we gabuhi yana tauhi aiyavo, i vinevinehi apo ina verehi.”
Maranai a tauvotagho ghehauhi 10 hi nonori aiwa James ma John hi dewadewaiya yana amohi i ghaighai.

Ma Yesu i ghorehi po auwarina hi viꞌemosi ma i riwehi ipa, “O hanapuwei, tauhi aiyavo vitaniwaga hi vaini ma rava egha mai Judea hei badehi, yana ahi kajijira i raghonihi, ma tautayahehi yana ahi taniwaga i vibagibagi po he rauꞌiviꞌapoꞌapoehi.”
Ma taumi auwarimi yana egha nanaꞌarena, inapa aiya i ghohei po wavana ina raꞌata yana ina vitaupaura aupoumi.

Ma aiya ina ghohei po ina tayaha, yana atapumi aubaimi ina vitaupaura. Babana Rava Natuna egha ita neꞌi po hina paurei ma tauna ina vitaupaura, ma a yawahana ina amverenei po rava maghamaghauhi ina gimarahi.”
Yesu, Bartimaes Matana i Viyawahani

Anima maranai Yesu a tauvotagho maitehi hi gheꞌeta au Jericho. Po maranai hi hopuhopu aharei yana rava boruhi maitehi hi nae. Ma rava emosi wavana Bartimaes, yana Timeas natuna matana keekena tayaha auririvana i tughura ma mane i gigimana.
Ma maranai i nonori da rava hi ririwa hipa, “Yesu Nazarethei e veraverauvira” yana i vighore ipa, “Yesu, David a umavou, ma raunuwa apoꞌapoeꞌu!”
Ma rava boruhi hi eni ma hi riwei hipa, “Ma genuwana!” Ma apoma ponana i raꞌata ma i ghoreghore duma ipa, “Yesu, David a umavou, ma raunuwa apoꞌapoeꞌu!”

Yamna aubaina Yesu i tumahiri ma i riwehi ipa, “Ona ghoreiya wehidana.” Eghabaine ravana matana keekena hi ghoreiyaꞌi po hi riwei hipa, “Nuwanuwam ina ahi ma ma vomahiri! E ghoreghorem ma ne auwarina.”
Ravana kaoha i dewai po ana anirauhawawara i ahare naiyei ma i vihauhepa, ma i nae Yesu auwarina.
Ma Yesu i raubayadei ipa, “Aiwa u ghoheꞌu po aubaim a dewai?” Ravana matana keekena i paribeei ipa, “Tauvihanahanapu, a ghohei po a inana.”
Yesu i riwei ipa, “Anima ma nae, am vitumaghana* i viyawahanim.” Ma mara emosi matana i wanakaiweni, po i inana ma Yesu tayahei i vimuritaghonaiyei.

footnotes.text: Yesu a tauvotagho hi amhuna duma babana mahura, yana mai Judea* hei vitumaghanei da Maimaituwa a viꞌahiꞌahina e raimoinei rava auwarihi. (Psalm 128; Proverbs 10:22)
Keyaka umana ma babataito yana e tereterenaiyei Yesu a hiraghe auwarina yana piripiri ma viuva apo inai aroniya.
-45 Yesu piripiri i viꞌaroni ma i hiraghe rava atapuhi epahiꞌahi po Isaiah 53i ririweiya ita raimoinei.

Maranai matakeke i vighore ipa, “Yesu, David a umavou” rava hi hanapuwei da weꞌi yana tauviyawahana ana wava ghehauna. Mai Judea* hi paꞌipaꞌi po Maimaituwa a Vinevine* ana rava ina viyawahanihi ma ina vitaniwagehi me guyauna David rorova ghooghahi i taniwagei. (Psalm 89:3-37; Isaiah 29:18-19, 35:5-6; Jeremiah 23:5-6; Ezekiel 34:23-24).
